2608.19147.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets
2608.19147.paper_summary: Modern Intel AI PCs ship capable integrated GPUs and NPUs with 16+ GB of unified memory, and they spend considerable time idle. That is not enough memory to fit a large model such as a 70B-parameter LLM. We show that a handful of AIPCs, working together over an ordinary network, can serve models beyond the capability of any single one. We use pipeline parallelism: a model is split by layer into per-stage shards, each pre-compiled into an OpenVINO graph, so that every machine runs one shard and passes activations to the next. Three techniques make this fast enough to be useful. First, we recover the speed of the unsplit model: a naive per-stage export runs well below monolithic inference because it misses an OpenVINO GPU optimization, and injecting a beam_idx Gather into each shard triggers that optimization (the IndirectKVCache fusion) and brings the shards to parity. Second, we leverage speculative decoding on stateful OpenVINO models. Third, the pipeline serves several users at once by interleaving their requests across the stages, each request carrying its own cache (micro-batching). Together, a two-node Llama 3.1 8B INT4 pipeline serves two concurrent users at 1.79x the single-user throughput of the unsplit model on the same hardware, and the gap widens under simulated wide-area latency. The same design scales to a 70B model that no single fleet member can hold: a four-node deployment of Lunar Lake AI PCs on Intel Tiber Cloud serves a single user at interactive speed, with output token-for-token identical to the same four-node pipeline decoding without speculation. Code, raw benchmark logs, and reproduction scripts ship as a self-contained package at https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper (in the top-level reproduction/ directory).
2608.19147.paper_summary_zh: 現代的 Intel AI PC 配備了具備 16GB 以上統一記憶體的整合 GPU 和 NPU，並且它們有相當多的時間處於閒置狀態。這樣的記憶體不足以容納像 70B 參數的 LLM 這樣的大型模型。我們展示了一小部分 AIPCs 在普通網絡上協同工作，可以服務超出任何單一 AIPC 能力的模型。我們使用管道並行性：將模型按層分割為每階段的碎片，每個碎片預先編譯為 OpenVINO 圖形，這樣每台機器運行一個碎片並將激活傳遞給下一個。三種技術使這一過程足夠快速以便實用。首先，我們恢復了未分割模型的速度：一個天真的每階段導出運行的速度遠低於單體推理，因為它錯過了 OpenVINO GPU 的優化，而在每個碎片中注入 beam_idx Gather 觸發了該優化（間接 KV 緩存融合），使得碎片達到平衡。其次，我們利用狀態開放的 OpenVINO 模型進行推測解碼。第三，管道通過在各階段交錯用戶的請求，同時服務多個用戶，每個請求攜帶自己的緩存（微批處理）。總體而言，兩個節點的 Llama 3.1 8B INT4 管道在相同硬體上以 1.79 倍於未分割模型的單用戶吞吐量服務兩個並發用戶，而在模擬的廣域延遲下，這一差距進一步擴大。同樣的設計可以擴展到單一艦隊成員無法容納的 70B 模型：四節點的 Lunar Lake AI PC 部署以互動速度服務單一用戶，輸出與相同的四節點管道解碼（無推測）逐字相同。代碼、原始基準日誌和重現腳本作為自包含包提供，網址為 https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper（在頂層重現/目錄中）。
